mapper.sql: ea.achievement_id as "achievementId", case when ea.achievement_type = 'LECTURE' then 'LECTURE_ACHIEVEMENT' else ea.achievement_type end as "achievementType", ea.achievement_status as "achievementStatus", ea.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ea.owner_user_id as "ownerUserId", value.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", value.value_text as "managementItemValue", ea.achievement_title as "achievementTitle", ea.occurred_on as "occurrenceDate", ea.evaluation_confirmed_yn as "evaluationConfirmedYn", ea.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from education_achievements ea left join lateral ( select management_item_code, value_text from education_achievement_management_values where achievement_id = ea.achievement_id order by display_order, management_value_id limit 1 ) value on true
order by ea.updated_at desc, ea.achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select count(*) from input_period_settings where evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and area_code = 'EDUCATION' and user_type_code = 'FACULTY' and active_yn = 'Y' and current_timestamp between start_at and end_at

insert into education_achievements ( achievement_key, achievement_type, evaluation_year, owner_user_id, achievement_title, occurred_on, created_by, updated_by, change_reason ) values ( #{achievementKey}, #{achievementType}, #{evaluationYear}, #{ownerUserId}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurrenceDate}, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerUserId}, '강의평가 실적 등록' ) returning achievement_id
mapper.update: update education_achievements set achievement_title = #{managementItemCode}, occurred_on = #{occurrenceDate}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select student_guidance_detail_id as "studentGuidanceDetailId", student_name as "studentName", guidance_start_date as "guidanceStartDate", guidance_end_date as "guidanceEndDate", student_count as "studentCount" from student_guidance_details where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by guidance_start_date, student_guidance_detail_id

select degree_completion_student_detail_id as "degreeCompletionStudentDetailId", degree_type as "degreeType", student_name as "studentName", thesis_title as "thesisTitle", degree_awarded_on as "degreeAwardedOn" from degree_completion_student_details where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by degree_awarded_on, degree_completion_student_detail_id

select from education_achievements ea left join lateral ( select management_item_code, value_text from education_achievement_management_values where achievement_id = ea.achievement_id order by display_order, management_value_id limit 1 ) value on true where ea.achievement_id = #{achievementId} and ea.deleted_yn = 'N'

select from education_achievements ea left join lateral ( select management_item_code, value_text from education_achievement_management_values where achievement_id = ea.achievement_id order by display_order, management_value_id limit 1 ) value on true where ea.achievement_id = #{achievementId} and ea.deleted_yn = 'N' for update of ea
mapper.update: update education_achievements set achievement_status = #{nextStatus}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = current_timestamp, change_reason = #{reason} where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N'

update education_achievements set deleted_yn = 'Y', deleted_at = current_timestamp, deleted_by = #{userId}, updated_at = current_timestamp, updated_by = #{userId}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select education_achievement_status_history_id as "historyId", previous_status as "previousStatus", next_status as "nextStatus", processed_by as "processedBy", processed_at as "processedAt", reason from education_achievement_status_histories where achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by processed_at desc, education_achievement_status_history_id desc limit 1
